speaker: Doctor
text: Let me start by asking: have you noticed any specific triggers for your weakness, such as fever, recent illness, or changes in your diet? Also, could you describe if this weakness is constant or intermittent?

speaker: Patient
text: 33-year-old woman. The patient reports feeling extremely fatigued and weak, especially towards the end of the day, to the point of difficulty in self-care. She mentions experiencing these symptoms currently. The patient has been traveling, hiking, and camping recently and notes having had multiple illnesses in the recent past.

speaker: Doctor
text: That sounds like a possible case of post-exertional malaise or an underlying autoimmune condition; have you noticed any muscle pain, swelling in your hands, or a butterfly rash on your face? Please also let me know if you have experienced frequent infections or joint pain.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Weakness and fatigue. I also have Mild diplopia.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis. REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_CT_to_check_for_thymoma.
